evidence: Enemy melee contact is resolved by closest-distance between the animated hand travel segment and the player capsule spine, using capsule radius plus sweep radius as threshold.
Attack lab mode stages the Orc at a fixed close range, resets player state, and strips normal orbit/retreat noise from repeat combat tests.
Large on-screen attack HUD exposes active window, lunge window, pre/post distance, probe reason, and travel values instead of tiny unreadable telemetry.
Enemy damage now interrupts player attacks, applies damage flash/health effects, and arms a player hurt/recover animation path on successful hit.
FPS arms now reserve time for hurt and recover states before returning to idle/walk, making received damage readable in first person.
Pose Lab FPS Arms profile now exposes FistInjuredRight, FistBlockHitLeft, FistBlockHitParry, FistReadied, and FistReady as first-class aliases for damage/restart inspection.
